title: Neil Armstrong Ejected Seconds Before His Craft Hit the Ground

scenes.text: Neil Armstrong ejected one moment before a crash.
It was May 1968, a year before the Moon landing.
He was flying a strange training craft, about two hundred feet up.
It lost helium pressure, and its backup thrusters ran dry.
Armstrong ejected, and the craft crashed in flames seconds later.
He floated down by parachute without a scratch.
He was reportedly back at his desk the same day.
A year later, he landed on the Moon.

description:
Neil Armstrong ejected seconds before his training craft crashed in 1968.
He was about 200 feet up when it lost control, and he parachuted down uninjured. A year later he landed on the Moon.
Would you have gone back up the next day?
first_comment: Bonus: engineers fixed the problems and flights resumed that October. Would you have flown it again?
